title: How to Create a File Module Provider

blocks.html: In this document, you’ll learn how to create a File Module Provider and the methods you must implement in its main service.

types.name: identifier
types.description:
Each file provider has a unique ID used to identify it. The provider's ID
will be stored as `fs_{identifier}_{id}`, where `{id}` is the provider's `id`
property in the `medusa-config.ts`.
types.example: class MyFileProviderService extends AbstractFileProviderService { static identifier = "my-file" // ... }
